narrative: Today's cluster names the very LiteLLM CVE this thesis listed in its signal set, now actively exploited and paired with Langroid's CVSS-9.8 SQLChatAgent flaw. Both run the same prompt-injected text-to-SQL path escalating to database-host RCE, confirming LLM-tooling exploitation is hardening into a live, repeatable attack pattern exactly as anticipated.
remaining_gap: No paired Linux-kernel LPE leg appears today, so the kernel-coupling half of the chain stays unproven; database-host RCE substitutes for the named root vector.
